categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Shibao Company Limited primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of automotive steering gears and key steering system components. The company serves commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and new energy vehicles with a comprehensive product line including manual rack and pinion steering gears, hydraulic, electric, and electro-hydraulic recirculating ball steering gears, and electric power steering systems such as CEPS, PEPS, DPEPS, and REPS. It also develops intermediate shafts and steering columns, focusing on intelligent and energy-saving steering solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including electric power steering systems, recirculation ball steering with various assistance methods, and intelligent wire-controlled steering and chassis technologies. It has seven core technical capabilities covering steering system design, rotary hydraulic control valve technology, electric power steering ECU technology, and intelligent wire-controlled chassis. Production employs intelligent assembly lines with online automatic assembly, testing, data storage, and analysis, adopting the Toyota Production System for flexible, efficient manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Zhejiang Shibao serves global leading automakers, acting as a Tier-1 OEM supplier with over 30 years of experience. Its major customers include prominent Chinese automotive groups such as Chery Automobile, Geely Automobile, NIO, and Li Auto, accounting for 66.01% of total sales. The company mainly supplies automakers directly, supporting passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production sites in Hangzhou, Yiwu, Siping, Wuhu, and Changzhou, and research centers in Hangzhou and Beijing. Domestic sales constitute over 92% of revenue, while overseas markets account for approximately 7.5%, with exports growing significantly. The company is expanding its international presence alongside its domestic market leadership.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Shibao operates as a midstream Tier-1 OEM supplier in the automotive supply chain, focusing on the development and production of steering systems and key components. It controls core component manufacturing and key processes internally, ensuring quality and cost control, and supplies directly to automakers based on their technical and quality requirements.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in automotive steering system safety, intelligence, energy saving, and lightweight technologies. It focuses on developing intelligent steering solutions such as steer-by-wire and rear-wheel steering to support autonomous driving. The company also emphasizes production process innovation, flexible manufacturing, and localization of automotive components to maintain competitive advantages and support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Zhejiang Shibao generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive steering systems and components to automakers. The sales are mostly based on vehicle package contracts, with a small portion from after-sales service markets. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance by customers, with production and procurement aligned to monthly orders from automakers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Zhejiang Shibao positions itself as a leading independent automotive steering system manufacturer in China with strong international customer resources. It is recognized for its advanced technology, stable product quality, and comprehensive product lines, maintaining a Tier-1 supplier status among major automakers and competing through innovation and cost advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.69 billion, a 48.04% increase from the previous year, with a gross profit margin improvement to 19.82%. Net profit attributable to shareholders nearly doubled to RMB 149 million. The company has expanded production capacity and R&D investment, with a stable and growing workforce of over 2,200 employees, reflecting strong growth and financial scale in the automotive components sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Shibao emphasizes safety, intelligence, energy efficiency, and lightweight design in its automotive steering systems, providing advanced active steering solutions for autonomous vehicles. Its competitive differentiation lies in strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, high-quality standards certified by IATF 16946:2016, flexible production systems, and long-term stable relationships with leading automakers, enabling it to deliver customized, innovative steering solutions globally.
